title: Azure Sorcerer (2006) - YourAnimeList
description: In the floating city of Celestine, magic is graded by color, and blue, the faintest shade, is a punchline. Apprentice Rio Ashby is the only blue-ranked sorcerer ever admitted to the Spire Academy, mostly by accident. When the city's ancient Wind Engine starts to falter, Rio discovers that blue magic isn't weak at all: it's the only kind the engine can hear. With a sharp-tongued crimson-ranked rival and a librarian who knows too much, Rio sets out to keep Celestine in the sky.
body: Ashgrove Animation's first television series. Its early-evening slot made it a gateway fantasy show for many younger viewers in 2006.

title: Neon Afterimage (2008) - YourAnimeList
description: Neo-Kanazawa, 2081. Bike courier Jin Kurogane can see afterimages, the trails of light people leave in the city's neon for exactly thirty seconds. When a delivery goes wrong and his client vanishes in the middle of a crowded street, the only witness is her afterimage, still running. Teaming up with Mei Sakaki, a hacker who runs her business out of a ramen stall, Jin chases a thirty-second trail across a city that never turns its lights off.
body: Remembered for its rooftop chase layouts. Layout artist Ren Okado's work here is often cited as the root of the silhouette-readable action fans praise in later series.

title: Skyfall Chronicle: Black Aegis (2009) - YourAnimeList
description: When the sky above the island nation of Aldera cracks open, armored Aegis frames are the only thing standing between its cities and the debris storm that follows. Cadet pilot Kai Seward is assigned the Black Aegis, a frame nobody else can even start. As the breach widens and the Aegis Corps runs out of time, Kai learns the frame hasn't been malfunctioning at all. It's been waiting for him.
body: Co-directed by Haruomi Sendo and Kaihatsu Miura. Miura's tight episode pacing is often credited for packing the story into a single cour.

title: Zero Latitude (2010) - YourAnimeList
description: The research ship Equinox sails the equator to study a phenomenon that stops compasses dead: at zero latitude, time skips forward a few seconds every night. Seventeen-year-old navigator-in-training Aoi Minase notices the skips are getting longer, and that someone aboard remembers the missing seconds. Between night watches, a captain who trusts only the logbook, and a physicist with a theory he won't share, Aoi has eleven nights to find out where the time is going.
body: Episode 7, "One Continuous Morning", contains a four-minute single-take sequence storyboarded by Tomoe Suzuhara that is still one of the most talked-about cuts of 2010. Director Kaihatsu Miura's first series as sole director.

title: River of Sparks (2010) - YourAnimeList
description: In the canal district of Hanabishi, street fighters settle their debts on the stone embankments while festival fireworks cover the noise. Former champion Souta Kirishima swore he was done fighting, until his younger sister's teahouse ended up on the wrong side of a bet. Now he has one autumn to win it back from the reigning champion, Ironside, without breaking the promise he made to Hotaru.
body: The alley fights were storyboarded by Tomoe Suzuhara with action choreography by Yusuke Kagura, a pairing fans still bring up whenever a new fight series airs.

title: Steelbound Testament (2010) - YourAnimeList
description: In a city held together by iron bridges, disgraced locksmith Edda Varn is hired to open a vault that has stayed shut for fifty years. Inside is the last will of the Architect, the man who built the city, and three factions are ready to go to war over what it says. With bridge warden Marcus Holloway breaking every oath he swore to help her, Edda has one night to read the testament before the city decides for her.
body: Produced by Flow Pictures' cinematic unit. Widely considered the film that made Flow Pictures' cinematic unit famous.

title: Sinful Apex (2011) - YourAnimeList
description: Seven towers rise over the city of Vellmore, and each is ruled by someone who made a deal with a sin. Whoever reaches the top of all seven, the Apex, is granted a single wish. Mercenary Lyle Crane is climbing for money. Street thief Nico Vale is climbing to clear a debt and sings to keep her nerve on the endless stairways. Floor by floor, the two find out what every tower lord already knows: everyone in Vellmore wants that wish.
body: Produced by Flow Pictures' late-era cinematic unit, the production is often described as the studio's "final breath". The singer LUNE appears as Aria Moonbirth, Vellmore's most famous performer, and sings the ending theme in character. Funmaxation is releasing a Complete Collection on Blu-ray on November 19, 2013.

title: Glass Cathedral (2012) - YourAnimeList
description: Every pane of the Glass Cathedral in Lindenmoor holds a memory donated by someone in town. When the windows begin going dark one by one, apprentice restorer Elise Hartmann has to find out whose memories are fading, and why the cathedral's newest window shows a morning that hasn't happened yet.
body: Studio Kinemachi reunited with series composer Tamaki Hoshino and character designer Sayo Kuramoto after Zero Latitude.

title: Circuit Hearts: Reload (2012) - YourAnimeList
description: In 2042, the android idol unit Circuit Hearts retired after one perfect concert. Ten years later, junk-shop kid Yuu Takamine finds their lead singer's core in a box of spare parts, and Nanase wakes up convinced it's still the night of the show. To finish that concert, the band has to be rebuilt, reloaded and re-rehearsed by someone who can fix anything but can't sing a note.
body: Studio Pulsewave animated the concert scenes in full, with every song performed in character.

title: Vacant Crown: Liminal War (2012) - YourAnimeList
description: The king of Varos died without an heir, and his throne has stood empty for nine years. Along the kingdom's liminal border, a twilight realm where the armies of the old kings still march, five claimants are fighting for a crown no one has dared to wear. Orphan cartographer Mirelle Aubert can map that border, which makes her the most valuable person on the continent and puts her right in the middle of the war.
body: Arc Meridian's first two-cour series, reuniting the Skyfall Chronicle team of director Haruomi Sendo, writer Mizuki Tobe and composer Kazane Ichijo. Funmaxation has licensed the series for North America.

title: Ghost Eater (2013) - YourAnimeList
description: High schooler Kenji Sakuraba can eat ghosts, and every one tastes like whatever it regretted most. Hired by Tsubaki Hoshimiya, a shrine maiden with a business plan and a very long client list, he becomes the city's least enthusiastic exorcist, one ghost at a time. Between a resident ghost who won't leave until her drama finishes and a detective who keeps getting his cases, Kenji's appetite has never been busier.
body: Ashgrove Animation and director Shizuka Ogura's first series together since Azure Sorcerer.
